Module 01 · Question Paper Generation

See the whole paper before it is built.

One row per question

Marks, time, unit and topic, difficulty, format and Bloom’s level, all visible in a single table.

Edit before you generate

Change any row, or go back and change the settings. Nothing is written until you confirm.

Set A and Set B together

Each set has its own distribution table, so you can compare them side by side.

Generation module · Question Distribution

Real product screen: an 18-question, 50-mark Project Management paper, Set A.

Module 01 · Question Paper Generation

Built on your syllabus, books and blueprint.

Your syllabus and books

Unit-wise syllabus and your reference books are the source. Questions come from your material.

Blueprint per question

Marks, time, format and difficulty are set for each question, not guessed for the whole paper.

Bloom’s level on every question

Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze and Evaluate, tagged for you.

Sets with a similarity control

Choose how alike Set B should be. Format and marks always match.

25% difficulty50% Bloom’s75% topic

Five question formats

MCQ, short answer, long answer, case study and true/false, with figures in the Word export.

Answer key with rubrics

Model answers and marking rubrics are generated with the paper and exported as a separate key.

Course outcome mapping

Each question can be mapped to your course outcomes (CO1, CO2 and so on).

Review and export

HOD review, regenerate any single question, then download Word, PDF or LaTeX.

Module 02 · Question Bank

Pick the units. Set the mix. The bank fills itself.

Three short steps

Subject and bank, units, then the question mix.

Share and marks for each format

For example 60% MCQ at 1 mark and 40% short answer at 2 marks, applied to every unit.

Difficulty and language

Easy, medium and hard split, with the language you teach in.

Runs in the background

The form shows the total and a time estimate. Leave the page and come back.

Question Bank · Generate questions

Real product screen: 20 questions from 2 units.

Module 02 · Question Bank

Nothing counts until you approve it.

Approve, edit or send back

Every question starts as a draft. Approve it, edit it, or move it back to draft.

Unit-wise picture of the bank

Questions by unit, a difficulty bar, a Bloom’s bar and a format split, all at the top.

Search and filter

Find questions by topic, unit or status. View by unit or as one list.

Flags for a second look

A question that needs attention is marked “Check this one”, for example when its answer key may not match the model answer.

Question Bank · Fashion Tech I mid-term bank

Real product screen: 24 questions across 5 units.

Module 02 · Question Bank

Build a paper from the questions you approved.

Pick by unit on the left

Add a question with one click. Reorder it or remove it on the right.

Sections, instructions and your logo

Set the time, the layout (UPES layout shown), and instructions for each section.

Fill automatically

Enter the marks you want for a section and the builder picks questions to reach it.

Live balance panel

Total marks, questions, units covered, difficulty and Bloom’s counts, with warnings such as mixed 1-mark and 10-mark questions in one section.

Question Bank · Build a paper

Module 03 · Question Paper Moderation

Nine checks before the paper reaches print.

Upload the paper. The checks run in the background and the results come back as a chart and a card for each check.

Module 03 · Question Paper Moderation

Exact wording. Exact fix.

Pinned to the question

Each finding names the question and quotes the phrase that causes the problem.

A suggested rewrite

Every issue comes with a suggestion you can copy straight into the paper.

Category or question view

Read the findings by check, or go question by question.

Moderation module · Ambiguity analysis

Real product screen: ambiguity findings for Q.5, Q.1 and Q.3.

Module 03 · Question Paper Moderation

Fix it where you find it.

Edit in the paper editor

Change question text, marks and sections. Add or reorder questions.

CO and Bloom’s per question

Pick them yourself or use Auto-Map CO. Marks add up by course outcome.

Review warnings before sign-off

Missing CO mapping or zero-mark questions are listed before you finalize.

Effective marks, always visible

Total questions, OR groups and an OR mark rule (higher, average or first) feed the live total.

Module 04 · Evaluation

Handwritten answers, marked like an examiner.

Scanned booklets are read, matched to each question and marked against your scheme. Marks are written where they were earned.

1The exact words that cost the mark, circledNot a total at the end. The reason on the page.
2A cross where a point is missed, a tick where it is earned
3The mark, written beside the answer
4A note in words: what was right, what was missed

Real student work, details hidden.

Module 04 · Evaluation

A booklet in. A marked sheet out.

STEP 1

Scan

Upload one PDF per student. Each page is matched to its question.

STEP 2

Evaluate

Rubric-based marking: each answer is read against your model answer and marking scheme, criterion by criterion.

STEP 3

Review

Open any question, see the rubric marks, and change a mark or a comment.

STEP 4

Reports

Student, class and exam-cell reports are ready as soon as marking is done.

Faculty stay in charge. Every mark and every comment can be changed by you.
